# Sad Machine Druid

Sad Machine Druid is a blue-green dark theme that shifts colours away from red and green toward cool teal and blue tones. Its description records dark-mode styling as what exists today, with fonts, a light mode and formatting for author dialogue named as planned additions.

![Sad Machine Druid screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/halftroll0/Sad-Machine-Druid/HEAD/sad_machine_druid_screenshot_v1.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Sad Machine Druid"
    author: "halftroll0"
    repo:   "halftroll0/Sad-Machine-Druid"
    slug:   "sad-machine-druid"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/sad-machine-druid"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/halftroll0/Sad-Machine-Druid"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/halftroll0/Sad-Machine-Druid/HEAD/sad_machine_druid_screenshot_v1.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a blue-green dark theme that shifts colors away from red and green toward cool teal and blue tones. Use dark-mode styling now and expect upcoming updates for fonts, a light mode, and formatting support for author dialogue."
}
```
